verdict.rationale: Multi-core compile and parallel-job performance is a core axis for a CPU, so the story applies. The evidence pack contains no documented core or thread counts, no boost clock behavior, and no independent multi-core benchmarks. Its official pages cover only GPU, NPU and AI capabilities, gaming, battery life, and generic statements that the CPU 'handles general-purpose tasks or sudden voracious workloads', none of which substantiate the story.
